Mysterious Signal Detected Near the Harbor

Scientists reported a mysterious signal detected near the harbor late last night while calibrating coastal sensors for an unrelated study.

According to researchers, the pulse lasted several seconds and did not match known shipping or military frequencies used in the region.

Local authorities have asked the public to remain calm while investigators collect additional recordings from neighboring stations.

A follow-up briefing is scheduled for tomorrow afternoon at the marine research center downtown.
